title: Port lock and login screens to Kirigami.Avatar
line: Users without a picture now get their initials on the lock and login screens, as in System Settings, instead of a generic face.
explanation: The shared user delegate of the lock and login screens drew its own Image plus a Kirigami.Icon fallback, clipped round by a custom shader, so users without a picture got the generic user icon. On the login screen SDDM also hands those users the theme's default face file, so a fallback to initials would never trigger there. The delegate is now a plain Kirigami Addons Avatar (initials without a picture, the picture cut round otherwise, with the same light ring as before), and UserList gains a placeholderIcon property that the SDDM Breeze theme sets to its default face so it counts as no picture. Avatar itself now cuts pictures round through a ShaderEffectSource and ShadowedTexture instead of a layer effect that was switched off with software rendering.

commits.message:
Avatar: Keep pictures round with software rendering

A layer effect cut pictures round but is turned off with software
rendering, so pictures showed as squares there. Draw them through a
ShaderEffectSource and ShadowedTexture, which work with both renderers.

BUG: 437418

lookandfeel: Show initials for users without a picture

Lock and login screens showed a generic icon for users with no picture.
Use Kirigami Addons' Avatar like System Settings, which also cuts the
picture round, and let themes name the placeholder face they hand out.

BUG: 437418

sddm-theme: Show initials for users without their own picture

SDDM gives users without a picture of their own the theme's default face, so
the login screen showed that generic face where System Settings shows their
initials. Tell the user list it is a placeholder, so they get initials.

BUG: 437418

patches.diff:
From a40b7e2e04960e88417018a0cf881ee4a14c8c7d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 03:27:18 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Avatar: Keep pictures round with software rendering

A layer effect cut pictures round but is turned off with software
rendering, so pictures showed as squares there. Draw them through a
ShaderEffectSource and ShadowedTexture, which work with both renderers.

BUG: 437418
---
 src/components/Avatar.qml | 37 +++++++++++++++++++++++++------------
 1 file changed, 25 insertions(+), 12 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/components/Avatar.qml b/src/components/Avatar.qml
index aa1decc4..f3b3f4ab 100644
--- a/src/components/Avatar.qml
+++ b/src/components/Avatar.qml
@@ -211,8 +211,6 @@ Item {
 
             anchors.fill: parent
 
-            visible: root.__showImage
-
             fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
             asynchronous: true
             retainWhileLoading: true
@@ -221,16 +219,31 @@ Item {
                 width: root.__diameter * root.Screen.devicePixelRatio
                 height: root.__diameter * root.Screen.devicePixelRatio
             }
-            layer {
-                enabled: GraphicsInfo.api !== GraphicsInfo.Software
-                textureSize: Qt.size(
-                    root.__diameter * root.Screen.devicePixelRatio,
-                    root.__diameter * root.Screen.devicePixelRatio
-                )
-                effect: Kirigami.ShadowedTexture {
-                    radius: root.__diameter
-                }
-            }
+        }
+
+        ShaderEffectSource {
+            id: avatarTexture
+
+            sourceItem: avatarImage
+            hideSource: true
+            textureSize: Qt.size(
+                root.__diameter * root.Screen.devicePixelRatio,
+                root.__diameter * root.Screen.devicePixelRatio
+            )
+            // The software renderer draws the texture as it is stored
+            textureMirroring: GraphicsInfo.api === GraphicsInfo.Software
+                ? ShaderEffectSource.NoMirroring
+                : ShaderEffectSource.MirrorVertically
+        }
+
+        Kirigami.ShadowedTexture {
+            anchors.fill: parent
+
+            visible: root.__showImage
+
+            radius: root.__diameter
+            color: circleBorder.color
+            source: avatarTexture
         }
     }
 }
-- 
2.53.0

From f9bc801963376de8a58365161fa9e0fc226b3cbd Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:58:37 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] sddm-theme: Show initials for users without their own picture

SDDM gives users without a picture of their own the theme's default face, so
the login screen showed that generic face where System Settings shows their
initials. Tell the user list it is a placeholder, so they get initials.

BUG: 437418
---
 sddm-theme/Main.qml | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/sddm-theme/Main.qml b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
index 3379ead93e..dddc652f76 100644
--- a/sddm-theme/Main.qml
+++ b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
@@ -175,6 +175,8 @@ Item {
             initialItem: Login {
                 id: userListComponent
                 userListModel: userModel
+                // SDDM gives this face to users without a picture: show their initials instead
+                userList.placeholderIcon: Qt.resolvedUrl("faces/.face.icon")
                 loginScreenUiVisible: loginScreenRoot.uiVisible
                 userListCurrentIndex: userModel.lastIndex >= 0 ? userModel.lastIndex : 0
                 lastUserName: userModel.lastUser
--

From dbd47de65dba5a6b575a881c733d1124cc2aaf7d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>

Subject: [PATCH] lookandfeel: Show initials for users without a picture

Use Kirigami Addons' Avatar like System Settings, which also cuts the

BUG: 437418
---

 lookandfeel/CMakeLists.txt               |  2 -
 lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.frag | 51 --------------------
 lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml  | 60 +++++-------------------
 lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml      |  8 +++-
 5 files changed, 21 insertions(+), 102 deletions(-)
 delete mode 100644 lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.frag

diff --git a/CMakeLists.txt b/CMakeLists.txt
index f93dda5aa7..2ce4e17442 100644
--- a/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -100,7 +100,7 @@ set_package_properties(KF6Kirigami PROPERTIES
 find_package(KF6KirigamiAddons 0.10.0 CONFIG)
 set_package_properties(KF6KirigamiAddons PROPERTIES
     DESCRIPTION "Extra controls for Kirigami applications"
-    PURPOSE "Required at runtime for the User KCM"
+    PURPOSE "Required at runtime for the User KCM and the lock and login screens"
     TYPE RUNTIME
 )
 
diff --git a/lookandfeel/CMakeLists.txt b/lookandfeel/CMakeLists.txt
index 822004bb18..7a05c34937 100644
--- a/lookandfeel/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/lookandfeel/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -24,9 +24,7 @@ qt6_add_shaders(components LNFSHADERS
     OPTIMIZED
     PREFIX "/qt/qml/org/kde/breeze/components/shaders/"
     FILES
-        components/UserDelegate.frag
         components/WallpaperFader.frag
     OUTPUTS
-        UserDelegate.frag.qsb
         WallpaperFader.frag.qsb
 )
diff --git a/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.frag b/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.frag
deleted file mode 100644
index a912e2eca7..0000000000
--- a/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.frag
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,51 +0,0 @@
-/*
-    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2014 David Edmundson <davidedmundson@kde.org>
-    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2014 Aleix Pol Gonzalez <aleixpol@blue-systems.com>
-    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2023 David Redondo <kde@david-redondo.de>
-
-    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later
-*/
-//draw a circle with an antialiased border
-//innerRadius = size of the inner circle with contents
-//outerRadius = size of the border
-//blend = area to blend between two colours
-//all sizes are normalised so 0.5 == half the width of the texture
-
-//if copying into another project don't forget to connect themeChanged to update()
-//but in SDDM that's a bit pointless
-
-#version 440
-layout(location = 0) in vec2 qt_TexCoord0;
-layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform buf {
-    mat4 qt_Matrix;
-    float qt_Opacity;
-    vec4 colorBorder;
-};
-layout(binding = 1) uniform sampler2D source;
-layout(location = 0) out vec4 fragColor;
-
-
-const highp float blend = 0.01;
-const highp float innerRadius = 0.47;
-const highp float outerRadius = 0.49;
-const lowp vec4 colorEmpty = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
-
-void main() {
-    lowp vec4 colorSource = texture(source, qt_TexCoord0);
-
-    highp vec2 m = qt_TexCoord0 - vec2(0.5, 0.5);
-    highp float dist = sqrt(m.x * m.x + m.y * m.y);
-
-    if (dist < innerRadius)
-        fragColor = colorSource;
-    else if (dist < innerRadius + blend)
-        fragColor = mix(colorSource, colorBorder, ((dist - innerRadius) / blend));
-    else if (dist < outerRadius)
-        fragColor = colorBorder;
-    else if (dist < outerRadius + blend)
-        fragColor = mix(colorBorder, colorEmpty, ((dist - outerRadius) / blend));
-    else
-        fragColor = colorEmpty;
-
-    fragColor = fragColor * qt_Opacity;
-}
diff --git a/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml b/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml
index 0f2d8d9c6e..e0adf007a5 100644
--- a/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml
+++ b/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ import QtQuick.Window
 
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents3
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.kirigamiaddons.components as KirigamiComponents
 
 Item {
     id: wrapper
@@ -41,19 +42,8 @@ Item {
         }
     }
 
-    // Draw a translucent background circle under the user picture
-    Rectangle {
-        anchors.centerIn: imageSource
-        width: imageSource.width - 2 // Subtract to prevent fringing
-        height: width
-        radius: width / 2
-
-        color: Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor
-        opacity: 0.6
-    }
-
-    Item {
-        id: imageSource
+    KirigamiComponents.Avatar {
+        id: avatar
         anchors.top: parent.top
         anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
 
@@ -66,48 +56,24 @@ Item {
         width: wrapper.isCurrent ? wrapper.faceSize : wrapper.faceSize - Kirigami.Units.gridUnit
         height: width
 
-        //Image takes priority, taking a full path to a file, if that doesn't exist we show an icon
-        Image {
-            id: face
-            source: wrapper.avatarPath
-            sourceSize: Qt.size(wrapper.faceSize * Screen.devicePixelRatio, wrapper.faceSize * Screen.devicePixelRatio)
-            fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
-            anchors.fill: parent
-        }
+        source: wrapper.avatarPath
+        name: wrapper.name
+        iconSource: wrapper.iconSource
 
-        Kirigami.Icon {
-            id: faceIcon
-            source: wrapper.iconSource
-            visible: face.status === Image.Error || face.status === Image.Null
+        Rectangle {
             anchors.fill: parent
+            visible: wrapper.avatarPath !== ""
+            radius: width / 2
+            color: "transparent"
+            border.width: Math.round(width / 50)
+            border.color: Kirigami.Theme.textColor
         }
     }
 
-    ShaderEffect {
-        anchors.top: parent.top
-        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
-
-        width: imageSource.width
-        height: imageSource.height
-
-        supportsAtlasTextures: true
-
-        readonly property Item source: ShaderEffectSource {
-            sourceItem: imageSource
-            // software rendering is just a fallback so we can accept not having a rounded avatar here
-            hideSource: wrapper.GraphicsInfo.api !== GraphicsInfo.Software
-            live: true // otherwise the user in focus will show a blurred avatar
-        }
-
-        readonly property color colorBorder: Kirigami.Theme.textColor
-
-        fragmentShader: "qrc:/qt/qml/org/kde/breeze/components/shaders/UserDelegate.frag.qsb"
-    }
-
     PlasmaComponents3.Label {
         id: usernameDelegate
 
-        anchors.top: imageSource.bottom
+        anchors.top: avatar.bottom
         anchors.topMargin: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit
         anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
 
diff --git a/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml b/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml
index 64f51da18d..30a22f9bc7 100644
--- a/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml
+++ b/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml
@@ -35,6 +35,12 @@ ListView {
     readonly property bool constrainText: count > 1
     property real fontSize: Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pointSize + 2
 
+    /*
+     * The picture the model gives users who have none of their own, such as
+     * the SDDM theme's default face. Those users get initials instead.
+     */
+    property url placeholderIcon
+
     implicitHeight: userItemHeight
 
     activeFocusOnTab: true
@@ -60,7 +66,7 @@ ListView {
         required property string icon
         required property string realName
         required property var model
-        avatarPath: icon || ""
+        avatarPath: icon && icon !== view.placeholderIcon.toString() ? icon : ""
         iconSource: model.iconName || "user-identity"
         fontSize: view.fontSize
         needsPassword: model.needsPassword !== undefined ? model.needsPassword : true

review.text: Porting UserDelegate to KirigamiComponents.Avatar and removing the custom fragment shader is the right overall direction and looks good on the lock screen with RHI rendering. However, the kirigami-addons Avatar.qml patch unconditionally creates an active ShaderEffectSource even for initials-only avatars, the SDDM placeholder check was only tested against a mock harness and does not reliably match real SDDM's FacesDir/.face.icon path/URL format, and UserDelegate.qml has regressions for broken avatar files, explicit session icons, and animated width resizing. All three commits also use BUG: 437418, which would prematurely close the bug.
changes: In kirigami-addons (src/components/Avatar.qml), gate avatarImage.visible, avatarTexture.visible, and avatarTexture.sourceItem on root.__showImage so initials/icon-only avatars do not allocate an offscreen ShaderEffectSource texture; also clarify the commit summary since software ShadowedTexture inscribes a square picture inside a circle rather than clipping it round.

Verify SDDM placeholder detection against real sddm-greeter / SDDM's UserModel (which defaults to FacesDir/.face.icon such as /usr/share/sddm/faces/.face.icon and may differ in path or file:// prefix from Qt.resolvedUrl('faces/.face.icon')) rather than relying solely on a mock harness.

In plasma-workspace (lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml and UserList.qml): do not show the thick textColor border Rectangle when Avatar falls back to initials after an image load error; use Avatar.InitialsMode.UseIcon when an explicit session iconName (e.g. 'Unused' sessions) should be shown instead of initials; and bind avatar.sourceSize to wrapper.faceSize * Screen.devicePixelRatio so animating width does not reload the image on every frame.
Use CCBUG: 437418 on the prerequisite repo commits instead of putting BUG: 437418 on all three independent MRs.

reviews.text: Porting UserDelegate to Kirigami Addons' Avatar with a placeholderIcon for SDDM's default face is the right answer to the bug, and the lock/login after shots show initials correctly. But the lock screen now hard-depends at runtime on org.kde.kirigamiaddons.components while plasma-workspace still finds KF6KirigamiAddons as an optional RUNTIME package, so a missing module would break the security-critical greeter. The kirigami-addons commit is scope creep with app-wide effects: every Avatar (NeoChat/Tokodon lists) now allocates a ShaderEffectSource texture even when showing initials, transparent pictures change background, and under software rendering it gives a shrunken inscribed square inside a circle (after-3), which is not clearly better than the old square. The placeholder match is an exact string compare with the theme's faces/.face.icon and misses SDDM's other fallback (FacesDir/.face.icon).
changes: Drop the kirigami-addons commit from this bug (or submit it separately with the texture only created/live when an image is shown, e.g. sourceItem/live bound to __showImage, and without changing the background of transparent pictures)
Make KF6KirigamiAddons a required dependency of plasma-workspace (and the SDDM theme packaging) or otherwise guarantee the greeter cannot fail to load, and say so in the commit
Also treat SDDM's global default face (FacesDir/.face.icon) as a placeholder, or compare normalized file paths instead of a raw URL string
Only draw the extra ring when the picture actually loaded (not when avatarPath points to a missing file and Avatar falls back to initials)
Test the SDDM change on a real sddm-greeter rather than only a mock harness
